meaning:
ἀσεβέω, -ῶ
(ἀσεβής), [in LXX for פָּשַׁע, רָשַׁע ;]
to be ungodly, act profanely: 2Pe.2:6; with cogn. accusative (MM, see word), Ju 15.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things…
